Variants.Content: In 212 BC, anti-Roman conspirators led by young Philemenos betrayed the wealthy port of Tarentum to Hannibal. Returning from a night hunt, Philemenos signaled the guards to open the postern gate, admitting Hannibal's assault detachment which stormed the lower city. However, the Roman garrison retreated into the sea-citadel, maintaining a defiant siege that prevented Hannibal from utilizing the deep-water harbor.
